reasoning: Two disjoint cliques of size 4 use only 8 vertices, leaving 2 vertices that cannot belong to any clique of size 4. Hence no graph with 10 vertices satisfies the requirements.
cot_trace: We need 10 vertices, exactly 2 vertex-disjoint cliques each size 4, that uses 8 vertices. Remaining 2 vertices? Must belong to one of these cliques, but cliques size 4, so can't. So impossible. Thus UNSAT.
